title: Wire frontend knowledge search to use hybrid semantic results
action: Update frontend knowledge hooks/components to send search queries through the new hybrid semantic search path. No UI changes needed — the search input in PersistedEntityTab already calls queryGraph which routes to graph-manager.searchEntities().

criteria: Frontend search query returns semantic matches (not just exact keyword matches)
Existing keyword search behavior preserved as fallback

implementation: Verify that PersistedEntityTab's search functionality works with the updated searchEntities backend. The frontend already calls queryGraph with search patterns — the backend change should be transparent. Add any needed query parameter (e.g., search_mode: 'hybrid') if the API needs to distinguish between keyword-only and hybrid search.
